exposure: Presence or absence of concomitant diseases
Mothers ≥ 35 years old with concomitant disease
outcome: Time from treatment implementation to the beginning of labor
Time from treatment implementation to delivery
finding: Comorbidities seem to increase the cesarean section risk in the misoprostol preinduction group, but in the dinoprostone group they prolong the time needed to achieve an active labor phase and delivery.
mod_finding: Among women with a concomitant disease, Caesarean section was observed more frequently in the misoprostol group.
